title: Metabolic constraints shape hypersynchronous dynamics in spiking cortical microcircuit models
task: Model metabolic constraints on cortical network synchronization and seizure dynamics

comments: The decoupling of electrical silencing from metabolic recovery is a crucial finding for understanding seizure suppression versus resolution, though single microcircuit scale may not capture long-range network effects.

inputs: Layer-specific parameters from human cortical recordings

hypotheses.hypothesis: Increased inhibition can suppress burst synchrony independent of metabolic recovery
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; inhibition-stabilized low-energy state achieved without restoring ATP

hypotheses.hypothesis: Network exhibits history-dependent transitions in synchronization
hypotheses.result: Supported; forward-backward parameter sweeps show readout- and dwell-time dependent bistability
